description: Gold value maths for the UAE: karat prices per gram/tola/ounce, making charge, 5% VAT and zakat. Libraries for JS, Python, Rust, Dart, C#, Ruby and PHP.
rules: Pass today's 24K price per gram; the libraries never fetch prices.
Round only on output: 2 decimals, half away from zero.
VAT is 5% on gold + making for jewellery; use vat 0 for investment bars.
